acceptance.description: Legacy DB migration creates the eight tables, one ticket per attempted/tailored row with R3 status, reason and system actor, normalized columns, backup; fresh install makes no backup; store_jobs fills normalized/last_seen columns
Second migration leaves tables, tickets, events, jobs count unchanged and makes no new backup, for applypilot.db and hireember.db
Scoring 7/6 gives one pending/skipped ticket, rescoring adds none, threshold setting and fallback to 7
Ordered history with time/actor/reason, same-status no-op, invalid status/actor/unknown ticket rejected without writes
Duplicate detection by text key and application URL blocks the second ticket; blocking vs non-blocking statuses; partial matches; empty keys; oldest linked; repeat refusal
Override with reason 'reapplying' starts the ticket and records a user override event; empty reason refused with nothing written
init_db, store_jobs and get_stats behaviour unchanged
